integrity: The infinite tail is proved by a parity-aware antipodal-gap EF strategy; the seven small finite cases are certified by exact exhaustive recursive types. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact partition concerns standard odd carousel tournaments in equality-plus-directed-edge first-order logic at rank four. The all-depth result is an upper bound only. There is no claim of exact rank-five classes or priority certification.
title: Sharp four-round logical classification of finite carousel tournaments
